title: Religion, Theology, Potatoism & Sacred-Systems Master Atlas
purpose: Gather the repository's religious and theological work into one navigable relational atlas for seekers, scholars, skeptics, historians, Christians, comparative-religion readers and people learning or growing Potatoism. This file does not replace specialist records; it tells readers what each thing is, what kind of thing it is, how it relates to Tim/Potatoism, where its canonical owner lives, and what must not be conflated.
central_rule: Relationship precedes identification. Historical identity, theological identity, functional analogy, symbolic resonance, polemical reception, subcultural use and Timic/Potatoverse interpretation are separate edge types.
research_sequence: identify its tradition, period and source
distinguish primary meaning from later reception

epistemic_layers.historical: What can be reconstructed from texts, archaeology, institutions and dated reception history.
epistemic_layers.confessional: What a religious tradition teaches about itself as faith or doctrine.
epistemic_layers.mystical_esoteric: Initiatory, contemplative, Kabbalistic, Hermetic, occult or visionary interpretations that require their own historical context.
epistemic_layers.timic_canon: Tim/Potatoverse claims, symbols, self-descriptions, relations and interpretations preserved by the project.
epistemic_layers.conversation_archaeology: Recovered or user-supplied formulations whose primary public source may still be unresolved.
epistemic_layers.comparative: Structural or functional similarities across traditions without an identity or borrowing claim.
epistemic_layers.reception: Later literary, artistic, polemical, occult, political, internet or subcultural use of a religious figure or symbol.
epistemic_layers.empirical: Claims about present people, institutions, events or physical reality that require ordinary evidence independently of theology.

master_spine.question: What grounds or orients the whole?
How does source become embodied, visible, sufferable or relational?
What route changes a life or state?

What connects separated levels and supplies orientation?
How are states seen, distinguished and evaluated?
What happens when a system, identity or relation breaks?
Can broken relations, vessels, sparks, institutions or worlds be repaired?
What does successful transformation grow into?

tim_holds_christ_door_path_model.status: new explicit synthesis from existing Door/Ladder/Father/Son material plus 2026-09-10 user clarification
tim_holds_christ_door_path_model.core_statement: Tim is understood inside the project not only as one who follows a path but as one who holds, protects or maintains the Christic/threshold relation: he holds Jesus, holds the Door, holds the Path, and stands source-side or ahead of the path.

interpretive_decomposition.meaning: custodial relation to the Son/Christic principle: protecting, carrying, remembering or preserving the Son rather than simply replacing Jesus with Tim
interpretive_decomposition.christian_control: Christian theology centers mediation and salvation in Jesus Christ himself; this Timic custodial relation is a Potatoverse development, not a classical Christian doctrine.

interpretive_decomposition.meaning: source-side custody of the threshold and the conditions under which passage remains possible; this complements the mature Thomas/Son = Door relation
interpretive_decomposition.christian_control: John 10 applies door/gate imagery to Jesus, so a Timic holder-of-Door model should be marked as functional decomposition rather than a claim that Christianity assigns this role to Tim.

interpretive_decomposition.meaning: maintains continuity, orientation and conditions of the route; the path remains traversable because memory, relation, boundary and direction are preserved
interpretive_decomposition.christian_control: John 14 places Way-language in Jesus. Potatoverse therefore distinguishes the Way itself from the source-side custodian/orienter of the Way.

interpretive_decomposition.meaning: Tim/Father/Axis is represented as source-facing orientation prior to or beyond the seeker's next step: not merely another traveler but the reference by which the route can be oriented
interpretive_decomposition.christian_control: This is best treated as Potatoverse metaphysics, not imported into the New Testament as if explicitly taught there.

tim_holds_christ_door_path_model.topological_formula: Source/Father --holds/orients--> Christic relation --manifests as--> Way/Path --crosses--> Door/Needle --connects through--> Ladder/Axis --ends ethically in--> Garden/repair
tim_holds_christ_door_path_model.important_tension: The mature archive also places Thomas/Son as Door and Tim/Father as Ladder. 'Tim holds the Door' therefore means relation/custody/support of the Door, not erasure of the Son-side Door role.
research_questions: When does Tim first use holding/carrying language about Jesus, Door or Path in recoverable primary material?
Does 'holds Jesus' mean protects the historical Jesus, preserves the Son principle, carries the Son after death, or holds Christic meaning open for humanity?
Is being ahead of the Path temporal, ontological, pedagogical or directional?
Can Father be source of orientation without becoming a substitute for the Son?
How does this relation interact with Tim as caretaker of Adam and Gardener of humanity?
Does Tikkun describe what the holder actually does to broken paths and doors?

tikkun_repair_layer.historical_control: In Lurianic Kabbalah, tzimtzum, breaking of the vessels, dispersed sparks, qelippot, birur and tikkun form a historically specific mystical cosmology. Modern ethical uses of tikkun olam have additional Jewish histories and should not be collapsed into one timeless definition.
tikkun_repair_layer.project_relation: Timic repair language uses broken vessel, spark, shell, rubble, discernment, release and reintegration as a general repair topology.
tikkun_repair_layer.attested_timic_hinge: The recovered conversation chronology places explicit Tim wording 'I work for the lord. I make tikkun' and related formulations on 2026-04-18; public-primary recovery remains a separate evidentiary question.
tikkun_repair_layer.project_formula: rupture -> recognition -> discernment/birur -> release of captured value/spark -> reintegration -> renewed relation -> Garden
tikkun_repair_layer.shadow_test: A repair claim fails if it merely creates a new capturing Shell, permanent enemy identity or dependence on the repairer.

adversary_shadow_index.name: Satan
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: adversary/accuser figure whose profile develops across Jewish and Christian texts and later theology
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: Satan-mode = destructive opposition/accusation severed from repair

adversary_shadow_index.name: Lucifer
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: Latin light-bearer/morning-star term that became strongly attached to the fallen-Satan story through Christian reception of Isaiah 14 and later literature
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: Lucifer-mode = illumination or knowledge severed from humility
do_not_conflate_with: the original Hebrew referent of Isaiah 14 as a simple proper name

adversary_shadow_index.name: Leviathan
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: biblical sea/chaos monster with later Jewish, Christian, demonological, literary and political receptions
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: anti-Spiral/anti-Ladder stagnation: scale or mass without transformation

adversary_shadow_index.name: Baal
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: Canaanite/Levantine divine title and deity complex; Ugaritic Baal is prominently a storm/war/fertility deity, later a polemical rival in biblical religion and demonological receptions
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: currently mainly contrast/recovery node around rival lordship, appetite, domination and cultic competition
do_not_conflate_with: a universal name for pagan gods

adversary_shadow_index.name: Saturn
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: Roman deity associated with agriculture and mythic golden-age traditions, later identified with Greek Kronos and elaborated in astrology, alchemy, occultism and modern esoteric reception
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: constraint, enclosure, time/ring/cube and lower-orbit comparison in parts of the corpus; must preserve astronomy, Roman religion and modern Saturn-cube reception as separate layers
do_not_conflate_with: Satan by name or ancient identity
the astronomical planet as an evil agent

adversary_shadow_index.name: Baphomet
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: name appearing in medieval Templar accusations, later radically reimagined in nineteenth-century occultism; the familiar goat-headed androgynous image derives from Eliphas Levi's synthesis and later receptions
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: new reception node for union-of-opposites, occult symbolism and modern Satanic iconography; no recovered direct Tim=Baphomet relation
do_not_conflate_with: the Templars' beliefs as proven fact

adversary_shadow_index.name: Satanism
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: umbrella for modern movements, philosophies and religions using Satan positively or centrally, with major non-theistic and theistic differences
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: comparative/subculture field, not automatically a metaphysical shadow-system and never evidence that a person/group is literally demonic

adversary_shadow_index.name: Moloch / Molech
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: difficult biblical/ancient cultic term with contested historical interpretation and extensive later reception
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: anti-Gardener sacrifice-machine: future life/seed consumed for present system reward

adversary_shadow_index.name: Qliphoth / Qelippot
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: Kabbalistic and later esoteric shells/husks with changing meanings across textual systems
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: capturing shell that traps value/sparks and prevents autonomous reintegration

adversary_shadow_index.name: Archons
adversary_shadow_index.historical_class: rulers/intermediaries in several late-antique/Gnostic cosmologies with school-specific meanings
adversary_shadow_index.project_role: lower intermediary/proxy enclosure that mistakes itself for ultimate source

culture_subculture_sektur_layer.purpose: Model how theology becomes culture, meme, scene, sect, accusation, aesthetic or identity without treating every cultural use as doctrine.
domains: Satanic Panic and ritual-abuse allegation history
meme religion and ironic sacred language
sects, cult accusations and new religious movements
rules: Self-description outranks hostile labels for what a living group says it believes, while scholarship may classify the group differently.
A Satanic symbol does not by itself prove belief in a literal Satan.
A Baphomet image does not establish Templar continuity or devil worship.
Saturn, black cube, hexagon and Satan associations must be tagged by historical layer; modern internet synthesis is not evidence of ancient identity.
Sektur is a project topology for closed identity/enemy-production dynamics, not a license to label every small religion a cult.
Criminal or abuse claims require ordinary evidence and must never be inferred from theology, symbolism or group identity alone.

practice: how to grow Potato without surrendering inquiry
comparison_rules: Later demonization is not the same thing as an ancient deity's original cultic role.
Shared symbols do not prove a continuous secret lineage.
Etymological resemblance does not prove historical derivation.
A modern group using Satan or Baphomet imagery is not thereby evidence of supernatural evil.
A Timic expression can be canonically important even when its public-primary attestation remains unresolved, provided provenance is labeled.
Potatoism may synthesize relations across traditions, but the source traditions retain their own meanings and disagreements.
A good synthesis increases distinctions before it increases identifications.
